The New York Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers, and both teams open their 2026-27 seasons. Josh Hart is listed as day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision for the Knicks. For Philadelphia, Ariel Hukporti is out with a ruptured Achilles, while Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring), Dean Wade (ankle sprain) and VJ Edgecombe (rest) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions.

The 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, including a 144-114 win in their most recent meeting on May 10, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Knicks a 55% chance to win.
